author: Jonathan Wright
text: My Septic tank situation was unique and a huge problem. The previous owners had built an extension of the home ON TOP of the septic tank. A septic tank mind-you that was 60ish years old and hadn't been maintained or emptied in over 20ish years. Beyond stupid decision making on their part. Zach at Bonzo and his workers were expert at handling the situation and repairing/replacing the old plumbing and installing the new septic tank. The old septic tank was dug into and emptied as much as possible. It feels so good to have working plumbing and be confident that it was done properly. 10/10 I recommend.

author: Brenda Getz
text:
Bonzo Septic Repair and his team did excellent work at installing a new septic tank at my house. He had to use a huge crane to lift the tanks over the house. It was exciting to see.
Zac and his team were friendly, knowledgeable and professional.
It was a pleasure doing business with him and his wife Stephanie.
I would definitely recommend his services in the future.
Thank you so very much for an amazing job.
Brenda G

author: Nicholas Black
text: Bonzo Septic has helped us with several issues at our home. Every experience we have had with their crew is always pleasant and enjoyable! They respect your time, show up when scheduled too, and very competitive pricing. They are my go to when I am in need of their services.

author: Sierra D'Amico
text: Unfortunately while trying to close on a house, we had a nightmare with the septic situation. Our closing window was tight and Bonzo excavating worked diligently to make sure we had everything we needed in a timely manner. There was some work done by another company during this time by the sellers that was less than desirable, but with Bonzo excavating’s expertise everything was fixed and the work was quality. We ended up with a brand new septic system for a reasonable price that was installed with careful attention to detail. Communication with the team was always easy and handled in a timely manner as well. I would highly recommend!

author: Ryan A
text: Excellent work done on my septic system. Good communication and better price on repairs than the bids received from other companies! Highly recommended!!
